PRODUCT INFORMATION

Details that deserve clarity.

A practical guide to the information to review before discussing a research-material order.

BEFORE YOU ORDER

Three things to review.

01 / IDENTITY

Product specification

Confirm the compound name, labelled strength, supplied format and intended research use. Ask for the specification for the material being offered.

02 / TRACEABILITY

Batch information

Request relevant batch identification and supporting records. Check that the records relate to the product and batch under discussion.

03 / ORDERING

Availability & delivery

Confirm current stock, pricing, delivery options and ordering terms directly with the team before arranging an order.
